以常见分页系统为例，页表与访问权限配合MMU实现地址翻译和隔离。同一虚拟地址在不: In typical paging systems, page tables, permissions and the MMU implement translation and isolation. The same virtual address can map to different physical pages in different processes, or be unmapped. An address in A is not necessarily invalid in B. Sharing, debugging interfaces and kernel privileges have conditions; isolation is not an absolute barrier to every attack.
管道、消息队列、共享内存和套接字适合不同通信方式；命名管道等也能用于没有亲缘关系: Pipes, message queues, shared memory and sockets suit different patterns; named pipes can connect unrelated processes. Shared memory may avoid some copying but still needs protocols, synchronization and permissions. Performance depends on message size, implementation and load. It is not universally fastest, nor do all alternatives perform exactly one copy.
线程通常复用进程地址空间与资源，仍需栈、内核调度信息及线程局部状态。进程创建也可: Threads reuse process resources and address space but still need stacks, scheduling information and thread-local state. Process creation can use copy-on-write instead of immediately copying all memory. Same-process switches usually keep the address space, without guaranteeing all cache or TLB state stays useful. This does not describe every thread switch.
共享可变数据需要按语言内存模型协调，例如锁、原子操作或消息传递；只读共享并不总需: Coordinate mutable shared data under the language memory model using locks, atomics or messaging; read-only sharing does not always require locks. Each thread uses its own stack, usually inside the shared address space. Escaping pointers to local objects can permit concurrent access, so both synchronization and lifetime matter.
读、计算、写是帮助理解的逻辑拆分，不保证编译成三条指令。即使每次读取和写入单独原: Read, compute and write is a teaching decomposition, not a promise of three machine instructions. Even separately atomic reads and writes can lose updates; use suitable atomic read-modify-write or synchronization. Unsynchronized C/C++ data races may be undefined behavior, so the final value is not predictably just too small.
先明确哪些状态会共享、谁负责同步，再用锁、正确的原子操作或消息传递建立约束。Th: Identify shared state and synchronization ownership, then enforce coordination with locks, correct atomics or messaging. ThreadSanitizer and stress tests can reveal exercised problems; silence is not proof of no race. Single-threaded actors still need correct async message ordering. Less sharing does not eliminate every concurrency bug.
先来先服务、短作业优先、轮转和优先级调度是常见教学模型，各有等待、公平与响应取舍: First-come-first-served, shortest-job-first, round-robin and priority scheduling illustrate different waiting, fairness and response tradeoffs. Real systems may combine strategies. Linux fair scheduling has evolved, including CFS and later EEVDF. No single data structure or algorithm is universal across systems and versions.
时间片长短要结合切换成本、任务数和交互需求评估，不存在通用的几毫秒最佳值。阻塞、: Evaluate slice length with switch cost, task count and interaction needs; there is no universally optimal millisecond value. Blocking, wakeups, priorities and CPU affinity also affect scheduling. Switching does not happen only when a slice expires. Interactive optimizations do not mean every I/O-waiting task always gets priority.
虚拟地址空间、已承诺内存和实际驻留页是不同概念。未访问区域可能尚未分配物理页，文: Virtual address space, committed memory and resident pages are different. Untouched regions may lack physical pages; file mappings can load on demand. Large spaces need not depend entirely on disk swap. Commitment and shortage policies may cause allocation failure or process termination, not unlimited overcommit.
多个进程可将同一物理页映射到各自虚拟地址，借此共享内存或只读文件页。共享库的可共: Processes can map the same physical pages at their own virtual addresses to share memory or read-only file contents. Shareable library code can be reused, while writable data, relocation, copy-on-write and mapping differences add costs. Isolation depends on mappings and permissions. Bounds errors can still corrupt data inside a process.
多级页表可按需建立下级表，避免为大片未用地址范围分配完整叶级表。级数依架构、地址: Multilevel tables allocate lower levels on demand rather than creating full leaf tables for unused regions. Depth varies by architecture, address width and configuration; 32-bit does not always mean two levels or 64-bit four. TLB hits avoid translation work; miss cost depends on page-table caches and hardware walking.
大页使一个TLB映射覆盖更大范围，适合某些较大工作集；具体尺寸和支持方式依架构而: Large pages let one TLB entry cover more memory and can help large working sets. Sizes and support are architecture-dependent. Costs may include internal fragmentation, allocation or compaction, and some workloads gain nothing. Evaluate faults, TLB behavior and latency, not coverage alone.
缺页异常可来自按需分配、文件页未驻留、写时复制、权限冲突或非法地址。处理可能是分: Faults may arise from demand allocation, nonresident file pages, copy-on-write, permission conflicts or invalid addresses. Handling may zero-fill, copy, read backing data or report an error; disk access is not universal. A page fault is normally a synchronous exception, even when informally called an interrupt. It is neither always normal nor always fatal.
为什么刚启动慢: Why cold starts can be slow
冷启动访问代码和数据可能触发缺页；页面若已在缓存中，就不一定产生磁盘读取。预读、: Starting with cold code or data can cause faults, but cached pages may avoid disk reads. Readahead, shared pages, storage speed and access patterns influence startup. Warming can help some workloads. Check actual faults and I/O rather than assuming every first access is slow or disk-backed.
回收策略常利用近期访问近似工作集，具体实现可采用时钟、多代LRU等。干净文件页可: Policies approximate working sets using recent access, with implementations such as clock or multigenerational LRU. Clean file pages can be dropped; dirty pages may need write-back; swapping anonymous pages depends on settings. Pinned pages may be unreclaimable. Not every page is simply the oldest one written to disk, and historical kernels are not universal current behavior.
工作集超过可用内存时，反复回收和重新访问可能令延迟急升。应先区分文件页回收、交换: When the working set exceeds available memory, repeated reclaim and reuse can sharply raise latency. Distinguish file-page reclaim, swap I/O, memory limits and other bottlenecks before shrinking workloads, reducing concurrency or adding RAM. Lower process limits can worsen reclaim or trigger termination; they are not a universal fix.
以ext4等inode模型为例，inode记录文件类型、权限、大小和时间等，并通: In inode systems such as ext4, an inode holds type, permissions, size, times and content locations through extents or other layouts; small data may be inline. Names mainly live in directory entries, and hard links allow several names for one inode. Early direct/indirect block schemes are not the only implementation.
inode编号通常只在所属文件系统内标识对象，因此普通硬链接不能跨文件系统建立。: Inode numbers identify objects within their own file system, so ordinary hard links cannot cross file systems. A file system is not synonymous with a partition. Symbolic links store paths and may cross file systems or dangle. Cross-file-system moves and hard-link creation are different operations.
目录项提供名字与对象标识的关联，具体存储可使用索引等结构，不一定是逐行扫描的小表: Entries associate names with object IDs, potentially using indexed layouts rather than a tiny linear table. Listing names reads directory contents; displaying permissions or sizes may also query metadata. Caches and formats affect cost. Every ls does not necessarily read every inode from disk individually.
常见Unix路径解析中，绝对路径从进程所见的根开始，相对路径通常从当前目录或指定: Unix absolute paths start at the process's visible root. Relative paths usually start at the working directory or a supplied directory descriptor. Resolution handles components, search permissions, symbolic links and mounts. Caches such as dentries reduce lookup work; each slash does not guarantee a disk I/O.
块大小影响分配粒度、元数据和IO组织，但不是块越大就一定越快。4KiB只是常见配: Block size affects allocation granularity, metadata and I/O organization; larger is not always faster. 4 KiB is common, and memory pages need not match file-system blocks. mmap is not thereby unconditionally zero-copy. Inline files, compression, sparse regions and shared extents also change actual usage.
支持稀疏文件的文件系统可以不为某些空洞分配数据块，读取空洞通常得到零。因此逻辑文: Supporting file systems can leave holes without allocating data blocks; reading them usually returns zeros. Logical file length can greatly exceed allocated space. ls commonly displays length and du allocation, depending on options. Copy or backup tools may preserve holes or materialize them, changing destination space use.
以ext4为例：data=journal让数据和元数据都经过日志；data=or: For ext4, data=journal journals both data and metadata. data=ordered journals metadata and orders related data writes before metadata commit. data=writeback lacks that ordering guarantee. Ordered mode does not journal all data first. Durability still depends on synchronization and device behavior.
日志可以缩短常见崩溃后的恢复，但不能修复所有硬件损坏，也不等于保证每个应用写入都: Journaling can shorten common crash recovery but cannot repair every hardware fault or persist every app write. Tools such as fsck check structures. Applications still need proper synchronization such as fsync and backups. Structural consistency, correct contents and retaining the newest data are distinct guarantees.
r=4、w=2、x=1，每组三位相加得到 0 到 7。rwxr-xr-- 对应: r=4, w=2, x=1; sum each group to obtain 0–7. rwxr-xr-- is 754. chmod 750 sets the basic groups to rwxr-x---, not just one bit. To add owner write while preserving other basic bits, use chmod u+w. ACLs and special bits have additional rules beyond this model.
目录 r 允许列出名字，x 是搜索权限，允许按名字查找目录项、遍历路径。仅有 r: Directory r lists names; x allows lookup by name and path traversal. With only r, names can be listed but files cannot be accessed through that directory. With x alone, a known name can be looked up. Reading a file also needs its own read permission and search access along the path. Creating or deleting entries usually needs parent w+x, with further restrictions such as sticky bits.
文件访问按进程凭据检查，有效组与附加组都可能参与；Linux具体使用文件系统UI: File checks use process credentials, including effective and supplementary groups. Linux specifically uses file-system UID/GID, normally matching effective IDs. New-file groups also depend on parent setgid and file-system rules, not only a login account's primary group. id reports the current environment's credentials, not every service's.
不考虑扩展ACL及特权时，先匹配所有者，再匹配文件组，否则使用其他人位；某组匹配: Ignoring extended ACLs and privilege, match owner first, then group, else others. A matched class with insufficient rights does not fall back to more permissive others. Extended ACLs add named users, groups and masks; path and other policies may still deny access. Nine mode bits are not a complete authorization model.
通常文件所有者可改权限，更改所有者需要特权。删除文件是在父目录移除名字，通常需父: Owners can usually change mode; changing owners requires privilege. Deleting a file removes a name from its parent, normally requiring parent w+x and path search, not write permission on the file itself. Sticky bits, read-only file systems and immutable flags can still block deletion. Directory w alone does not mean unrestricted deletion.
在 Linux 中，受支持且未被挂载或安全策略禁用时，setuid 可让可执行文: On Linux, supported setuid executables may run with the file owner's effective identity unless mounts or security policy disable it. Directory setgid gives new files the directory's group. Sticky directories further restrict deletion and renaming, usually to file owners, directory owners or suitably privileged processes, while other permission conditions still apply.
Linux将传统root权力拆为capabilities，例如绕过部分文件自主访: Linux splits traditional root powers into capabilities. Bypassing some discretionary file checks and changing ownership are different capabilities. Capability sets, user namespaces, read-only mounts and security modules can still constrain actions. High privilege expands direct damage from mistakes or compromise, but root does not bypass every check.
服务用专用身份，限制所需文件、网络、能力和凭证；管理操作按需提权，并核对实际策略: Use dedicated service identities and restrict files, networks, capabilities and credentials. Elevate for administration as needed and verify policies and audits. Non-root containers, read-only mounts and capability limits help, but no one measure guarantees isolation. An account's current rights are not an absolute upper bound on attack damage.
常见Unix实现可先fork，再由子进程exec替换程序映像；也可能采用其他等价: Unix implementations commonly fork, then exec in the child to replace its program image, or use equivalent mechanisms. fork usually uses copy-on-write instead of immediately copying all memory. Foreground jobs commonly wait; background jobs differ. The exec built-in can replace the current shell. Inheriting an environment does not let a child directly change parent-shell variables.
cd和export等内置命令需要在当前shell中执行，才能改变它的目录或环境设: cd and export need to run in the current shell to change its directory or environment. Changes in subshells, separately run scripts or certain pipeline environments usually do not flow back. The dot command runs a script in the current environment. Built-ins are not only for state changes; consider the specific command and context.
以Linux procps为例，R为运行或可运行，S为可中断睡眠，D为不可中断睡: Linux procps uses R for running/runnable, S for interruptible sleep, D for uninterruptible sleep, Z for zombie and T for stopped. D often relates to I/O but does not alone prove disk failure. Zombies can be briefly normal. Consider duration, stacks and parent–child relationships.
Linux的load average包含可运行任务及部分不可中断等待，不能直接等: Linux load average includes runnable tasks and some uninterruptible waits, not just CPU utilization. us, sy and wa measure different CPU-time categories; wa is not a particular disk's utilization. Combine process, I/O, latency and sampling information rather than inferring cause from one high number.
管道是内核缓冲区: A pipe is a bounded byte stream
以Linux管道为例，它提供有限容量的字节流缓冲。默认阻塞模式下，空管道读端可能: A Linux pipe has finite buffering. In blocking mode, readers may wait on empty pipes and writers on full pipes. Nonblocking calls may report temporary unavailability; writes with no readers behave differently. Capacity depends on implementation and configuration, so applications should not assume a fixed number of KiB.
POSIX风格shell用退出状态控制&&和||等连接：零通常表示成功，非零需按: POSIX-style shells use status for && and ||. Zero normally indicates success; nonzero meanings depend on the program. A normal pipeline usually reports its last command's status; supported, enabled pipefail changes that rule. Distinguish signal termination from normal exit. Success at the end does not prove every pipeline stage succeeded.
SIGINT常由终端Ctrl+C发给前台进程组，SIGTERM请求终止；SIGH: Terminal Ctrl+C commonly sends SIGINT to the foreground process group. SIGTERM requests termination. Some services interpret SIGHUP as reload, but that is not universal. SIGKILL and SIGSTOP cannot be caught, blocked or ignored. SIGSEGV can have a handler, but handling it does not prove safe recovery from illegal memory access.
服务可在收到TERM后停止接收新工作，完成或取消在途任务，并在期限内释放资源。处: After TERM, a service can stop accepting work, finish or cancel in-flight tasks and release resources within a deadline. Signal handlers must obey async-signal-safety rules; complex cleanup usually belongs in normal execution. Readiness, liveness and orchestrator behavior need separate design. KILL skips application cleanup, though the kernel still reclaims process resources.
